panel.title: Edit Question Start and End Times — $ctf_event_name$

ul.li: Confirm the correct CTF is selected above.
These times apply only to questions belonging to the selected CTF.

search.query: | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval dontcare="$somethingchanged$" | stats min(StartTime) as MinStartTime | eval NiceStartTime=strftime(MinStartTime,"%+") | fields NiceStartTime
| inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval dontcare="$somethingchanged$" | stats max(EndTime) as MaxEndTime | eval NiceEndTime=strftime(MaxEndTime,"%+") | fields NiceEndTime

| inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval dontcare="$somethingchanged$" | eval NiceStartTime=strftime(StartTime,"%+"),NiceEndTime=strftime(EndTime,"%+") | sort StartTime Number | fields Number Question BasePoints NiceStartTime StartTime NiceEndTime EndTime
